The remember-me checkbox forgets everyone after a browser restart, regardless of settings.
Duplicate charges appear when a customer double-clicks the pay button - no idempotency on that endpoint.
Filtering the incidents table by severity silently drops rows older than 30 days.
German umlauts in project names turn into mojibake in the exported PDF.
The mobile app logs users out every time it switches from wifi to cellular.
Teams would pay for per-project permission tiers - right now it is all-or-nothing.
An unread badge on the inbox tab would save people from scrolling every morning.
Could the search box accept status:open style filters? We chain them in Jira daily.
A dark theme for the status page has been requested by several enterprise accounts.
Letting admins bulk-invite via pasted email lists would remove a real onboarding bottleneck.
The installation page points to Node 14, which the current release no longer supports.
The webhook signing guide skips the timestamp tolerance step - integrators keep failing verification.
Release notes for the last two versions are still empty placeholders.
The troubleshooting section assumes Docker; there is nothing for bare-metal installs.
The API docs show curl examples with the old base URL, so copied commands hit a dead host.
Invoice PDF generation grinds for about forty seconds on accounts with over a thousand line items.
Search autosuggest fires a request per keystroke and latency falls apart under load.
Dashboard panels take half a minute to load when the time range exceeds thirty days.
Worker throughput halves whenever log level is set to debug - we lose thousands of jobs per hour at peak.
Cold starts on the image resizer hit six or seven seconds after each deploy, thawing only with traffic.
